title: Dice an onion
summary: Halve, slice and dice an onion into even little cubes, safely.
notes: Knife lesson: safety alerts come first and no roasts while the knife is moving.

steps.instruction: Cut the onion in half through the root, then peel off the papery skin. Leave the root end on: it holds the layers together.
steps.done_when: Two peeled halves, root still on, lying flat side down.

steps.instruction: Flat side down, slice towards the root in thin strips, stopping just before the root. Fingertips tucked in a claw.
looks_right: knife stops short of the root
looks_wrong: fingers flat in front of the blade
steps.done_when: One half is sliced into strips still joined at the root.

steps.instruction: Turn it and slice across the strips to make little cubes. Finish the second half the same way.
steps.done_when: A neat pile of evenly diced onion.
